stem.text: The transmission electron micrograph shows a cell in a stage of the mitotic cell cycle.

stem.alt: Greyscale transmission electron micrograph of a cell with its internal structures visible.

stem.text: Which statement explains why it is difficult to identify the stage of the mitotic cell cycle shown?

A.text: Chromosomes have supercoiled and are visible, but centrioles are not visible.

B.text: Anaphase may be continuing, or telophase may be starting.

C.text: It is unclear whether the electron micrograph shows two cells in metaphase.

D.text: Some people may consider interphase to have started.
